name: Victor Pena
bio: Originally from Spain, Victor is an iOS engineer working at Uber, helping payments go smoothly in an app with more than 75 million monthly active users. He has been working on iOS since 2010, and before Uber, he used to work at TomTom. There, he was an engineering manager in the team that built the new generation of the navigation app, with more than 10 million installs.
